description: SDA-Adap - Etude Schéma d'Accessibilité des Transports - Points d'arrêts routiers - Saint-Lô Agglo - Mars 2021 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Saint-Lô Agglo. Saint-Lô Agglo has decided to draw up its Master Plan of Accessibility of Collective Transport, Agenda of Accessibility Programmed on its Slam Bus network following the enabling law n°2014-789 of 10 July 2014 and its various decrees, orders and orders supplementing it. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Saint-Lô Agglo. The portal shows the English title as "SDA-Adap — Study Transport Accessibility Schema — Road Stop Points — Saint-Lô Agglo — March 2021" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Saint-Lô Agglo. Its keywords include arrets, points-darrets, saint-lo-agglo, transports-publics, arrets-de-bus, accessibilite. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
